Scaffold a new Next.js 15 SaaS project called Clientloop at `~/Clientloop`. The directory does not exist yet. This is Phase 1 UI-shell-only (mock data, no backend, no auth). Full plan lives at `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/zany-mixing-flame.md` — read it first for full context before executing.

Environment confirmed:
- node v20.20.1
- pnpm 10.33.0 (just enabled via corepack)
- macOS darwin 25.1.0
- Working dir: /Users/yashbaldha

Product: Clientloop — AI-native client HQ for productized agencies. Brand color violet #6d28d9. Full context in the dossier paste inside the plan file and in `~/.claude/memory/projects/REGISTRY.md` (which does NOT yet list Clientloop — Mira will add it later).

## Your job — Step 1 only

1. **Scaffold** at `~/Clientloop`:
   ```
   cd ~ && pnpm create next-app@latest Clientloop --ts --tailwind --eslint --app --no-src-dir --import-alias "@/*" --use-pnpm --turbopack
   ```
   Use `--yes` or answer prompts non-interactively. If create-next-app prompts for anything unexpected, pick the modern default.

2. **Init shadcn/ui**:
   ```
   cd ~/Clientloop && pnpm dlx shadcn@latest init
   ```
   Config: New York style, Neutral base color, CSS variables YES. If it fails on non-interactive mode, create `components.json` manually with these exact values and then run `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add` with components.

3. **Install shadcn primitives in one batch**:
   `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add sidebar button card table tabs badge input textarea dialog dropdown-menu avatar separator skeleton sonner tooltip select breadcrumb sheet scroll-area label form switch`

4. **Configure tsconfig.json strictness** — add under compilerOptions:
   - "strict": true (should already be there)
   - "noUncheckedIndexedAccess": true
   - "noImplicitReturns": true
   - "noFallthroughCasesInSwitch": true

5. **Inter font** — update `app/layout.tsx` to load Inter via `next/font/google` (subsets: ["latin"], variable: "--font-sans"), set on `<body>` via `font.variable` class, keep `suppressHydrationWarning` on `<html>`.

6. **Tailwind config** (`tailwind.config.ts` — create if Next.js scaffold gave you `tailwind.config.js`, prefer .ts):
   - Extend `fontFamily.sans` with `var(--font-sans)`
   - Extend `boxShadow`:
     - `soft: "0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.02), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.02)"`
     - `"soft-md": "0 4px 12px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04), 0 2px 6px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.03)"`
     - `card: "0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.03), 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04)"`
   - Extend `keyframes`:
     - `fade-in-up: { "0%": { opacity: "0", transform: "translateY(8px)" }, "100%": { opacity: "1", transform: "translateY(0)" } }`
   - Extend `animation`:
     - `"fade-in-up": "fade-in-up 0.4s ease-out"`

7. **Set radius** — in `app/globals.css`, under `:root`, ensure `--radius: 0.75rem;` (shadcn init may set 0.5rem — override to 0.75).

8. **Update metadata** in `app/layout.tsx`:
   - title: `"Clientloop — AI-native client HQ for productized agencies"`
   - description: `"Turn messy client requests into structured briefs with AI. Flat pricing, Stripe + Razorpay, mobile-first. Built for modern productized agencies."`

9. **Create `CLAUDE.md`** at `~/Clientloop/CLAUDE.md` with:
   - Project: Clientloop
   - Stack lock: Next.js 15 + TS strict (no `any`) + Tailwind + shadcn/ui
   - Phase 1 scope: UI shell only, mock data in `lib/mock/`, no backend
   - Deferred: auth (Clerk), DB (Neon+Prisma), payments (Stripe+Razorpay), AI brief feature, landing page
   - Reference: full plan at `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/zany-mixing-flame.md`
   - Gate: Phase 15 validation (300 waitlist + 10 LOIs) before any backend work
   - Rules: no `any`, no `@ts-ignore`, use shadcn Sidebar (never custom), never hardcode colors, always wrap authed pages in SidebarLayout

10. **Create `README.md`** — 10 lines max, product positioning + how to run.

11. **Initialize git**, make first commit:
    ```
    git init && git add -A && git commit -m "chore: scaffold Clientloop Phase 1 UI shell"
    ```

12. **Verify build**:
    - `pnpm tsc --noEmit` → zero errors
    - `pnpm lint` → zero errors
    - `pnpm build` → succeeds

## Constraints
- NO `any`, NO `@ts-ignore`, NO type assertions
- NO extra files beyond what's listed
- NO business logic yet — this is scaffold ONLY
- If shadcn `add` fails on interactive prompts, use `--yes` flag or set `CI=1` env var
- If `next build` warns about Inter font on dynamic OG, ignore — not in scope
- Don't touch `app/page.tsx` content yet (that's Step 3's route group redirect — leave the default Next.js landing page for now OR replace with a simple `<main>Clientloop scaffold ready</main>` so the build has no Next.js boilerplate)

## Report back
- Confirm `~/Clientloop` exists
- Paste `pnpm --version`, Next.js version from package.json, shadcn components installed
- Confirm tsc/lint/build all pass
- Confirm git log shows the first commit
- Report any deviations from the plan and why
- Under 300 words

1	# Clientloop — Phase 1 UI Shell Plan
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	Clientloop is the codename (from Phase 18 dossier candidates) for the ManyRequests-style SaaS already researched across 22 phases in the Boldteq dossier (`ManyRequestsDossier.jsx`). The dossier returned a **conditional GO** with a hard gate at Phase 15: 300 waitlist + 10 paid LOIs before writing code.
6	
7	Yash is **intentionally overriding** the gate for a narrow purpose: build the **UI shell only** (mock data, no backend, no auth wiring) so it can be **used as the clickable validation asset** Phase 15 already requires (Figma-alternative prototype for LOI interviews). This is the cheapest path to satisfy the gate without wasting build effort later — the shell becomes real production code once the gate passes.
8	
9	**What we are building in Phase 1:**
10	- Agency-side UI shell for Clientloop
11	- Next.js 15 App Router + TypeScript (strict, no `any`) + Tailwind + shadcn/ui
12	- Three working screens: Dashboard Home, Request Inbox (table + Kanban toggle), Clients/Services/Settings
13	- All data mocked in `lib/mock/` — zero backend, zero auth, zero DB
14	- Fully responsive, dark-mode capable, production-quality look
15	- Deployable to Vercel as a static demo on day 1
16	
17	**What we are NOT building:**
18	- No Clerk, Neon, Prisma, Razorpay, Stripe, Claude API, tRPC
19	- No Request Detail + AI Brief screen (deferred — dossier's hero feature, but not in this pass per user selection)
20	- No client-facing portal (agency side only)
21	- No landing page / marketing site (separate Quill work later)
22	
23	**Why it matters:** the dossier's wedge is AI request-to-brief + flat pricing + Razorpay. The UI shell must *look* like a product that ships those things, even though none are wired. Visuals sell the LOIs.
24	
25	---
26	
27	## Name & Branding
28	
29	- **Product name (Phase 1):** Clientloop
30	- **Rationale:** shortest, most pronounceable of the 10 candidates, and the word "loop" ties directly to Phase 21's client-invite viral loop (the actual growth engine)
31	- **Trademark risk:** NOT cleared — dossier flags CHECK gate. Treat name as provisional. Use it in UI, but do not register domains or trademarks yet
32	- **Wordmark:** plain text `Clientloop` in Inter bold for v1, no logo commissioned yet
33	- **Primary color:** Violet (`#6d28d9`) — already used in the dossier artifact header, carries forward as brand accent
34	
35	---
36	
37	## Architecture Decision: Scaffold Fresh
38	
39	Confirmed via Explore agent: no existing Next.js projects in Yash's active portfolio. Rankora and CROBOT are both Vite+React+React Router (Lovable-origin) — not migratable to Next.js 15 App Router. shadcn components and Tailwind tokens are portable; everything else is a rewrite.
40	
41	**Decision:** `pnpm create next-app@latest Clientloop` at `~/Clientloop`. Copy token structure from Rankora's Tailwind config but nothing else.
42	
43	**Memory impact:** create `~/.claude/memory/stacks/saas-nextjs-15.md` after scaffold so the next Next.js SaaS inherits these patterns. (Mira runs this after Phase 1 completes.)

# Clientloop — Project Instructions

**Project:** Clientloop
**Stack:** Next.js 16 (App Router) + TypeScript strict (no `any`) + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui (base-nova style)
**Brand color:** Violet `#6d28d9`
**Phase:** 1 — UI shell only

## Phase 1 Scope

Mock data only. All data lives in `lib/mock/`. Zero backend, zero auth, zero DB.

Deferred to Phase 2+ (only after Phase 15 gate: 300 waitlist + 10 LOIs):
- Auth: Clerk
- Database: Neon + Prisma
- Payments: Stripe + Razorpay

## Full Plan

`/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/zany-mixing-flame.md`

## Stack Lock

- Next.js 16 App Router — `app/` directory, Server Components by default
- TypeScript strict — `strict: true`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true`, `noImplicitReturns: true`
- **No `any`. No `@ts-ignore`. No type assertions.** Zero exceptions.
- Tailwind v4 CSS-first (no `tailwind.config.ts` — tokens in `app/globals.css` `@theme inline`)
- shadcn/ui `base-nova` style — `components.json` is locked, never regenerate
- pnpm only — never npm or yarn

## Architecture Rules

- All authed/dashboard pages MUST be wrapped in `(dashboard)/layout.tsx` which provides `SidebarProvider` + `AppSidebar` + `SidebarInset`
- Never build a custom `<aside>` — use shadcn Sidebar primitives exclusively
- Never use `useSidebar()` ternaries for active/inactive styling — use `group-data-[collapsible=icon]:*` CSS classes
- Active sidebar item: `text-white` on primary background — NOT `text-primary`
- Never hardcode colors (no `#6d28d9` inline) — use CSS variables via Tailwind utilities
